description: FeedStore: snapshot replaces rows; delta applies removed (key strings or {key}), then added, then updated (merged over the existing row). Rows sort pending first, then newest ts (missing ts = 0), then key ascending; at most max_rows (null = default 200, 0 = unlimited) are kept, dropping the tail. expect is the store state after each step.

cases.name: snapshot then deltas, pending first then newest
equal ts ties break by key ascending; missing ts sorts as 0
updated merges fields into existing row and inserts unknown keys; removing unknown key is a no-op
delta without version keeps previous version; maxRows 0 is unlimited
